text:
jamie_cs: Quick ask — Solara kickoff tomorrow morning. Can we put a compact 5-line customer blurb about caching / batching / streaming into the invite, a tiny drop-in engineer snippet, and a short 72h renewal watchlist?

rod_engineer: Invite blurb (copyable):
• Prefer streaming for interactive experiences so users see incremental output.
• Use prefix caching for stable system prompts (welcome, policy) to reduce latency & cost.
• Maintain a small warm pool after deploys to avoid cold-start tails.
• Batch async workloads where latency allows (batch size 4–8 typical).
• Collect quick thumbs-up/slow feedback in-product and review daily first 3 days.

anya_cs: Engineer drop-in (example config, tune to traffic):
```yaml
inference:
  warm_pool: 2
  batch:
    max_size: 6
    max_wait_ms: 75
  streaming: true
  prefix_cache_ttl: 3600  # seconds
```
Note: reduce max_wait_ms for chat UIs.

kevin_oncall: 72h renewal watchlist (prioritize alerts):
• p95 latency > 500ms sustained > 30 minutes on any critical route
• tokens/day per active seat drops > 35% vs baseline
• repeated 5xxs or queue depth rising > 2x typical
• prefix cache hit-rate < 50% after warmup period
• >2% of responses flagged negative in-product feedback

ops-bot: Reminder set: run health check at +12h, +24h, +72h; post results to thread. :bell:

jamie_cs: Perfect — I'll paste the blurb + snippet into the invite and enable the reminders. If any of the watchlist signals fire I'll escalate to eng and schedule a customer touchpoint. Thanks!
